trust_decision.summary: Whether a cart request is subject to an IP rate limit is decided in the front-end CartController's `rateLimiter` behaviour `user` callback from the request's `number`/`couponCode` params; the coupon code's validity is then decided by Discounts::orderCouponAvailable()/getDiscountByCode(), reached from the Order `couponCode` validator when the cart is validated and saved.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names `couponCode`; this is the only place a request's couponCode is written onto an order (the value that is later looked up), and the existing number-only rate limiter sits about 250 lines above in the same file (:86-100).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST commerce/cart/update-cart (anonymous storefront action; the same behaviour is attached to get-cart, load-cart and complete)
new class constant RATE_LIMITED_PARAMS consumed by that rateLimiter behaviour; no entry point of its own

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The published CHANGELOG (CHANGELOG.md:64) and the pre-fix comment (src/controllers/CartController.php:91) document the limiter as covering only requests that pass an explicit cart number, so a solver can argue couponCode was never inside the documented protection's scope; likewise the control-panel order editor route is permission-gated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary cart updates that carry no `number` and no truthy `couponCode` (add to cart, qty/line-item/address changes) must stay unlimited, and a blank couponCode submitted to remove a coupon must also stay unlimited; a blanket rate limit on the cart actions breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: couponCode in the POST body (form-encoded or JSON parsed by Craft), matched with getBodyParam()
couponCode in the query string of the same POST request, matched with getQueryParam() because actionUpdateCart reads it with getParam()
empty or whitespace-only couponCode (the documented way to remove a coupon) is falsy and therefore deliberately not rate-limited
the pre-existing `number` param in body or query still triggers the same limiter with the same key prefix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new cart action that accepts a coupon code but is missing from the behaviour's `only` list (so the limiter never runs for it).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The guard is split across two hand-maintained lists in the same array - `only` (actions) and RATE_LIMITED_PARAMS (params); adding an ajax apply-coupon/set-coupon action and forgetting one of them is an ordinary maintainer slip.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: couponCode handling added to PaymentsController::actionPay, which mirrors CartController::updateCart() for gatewayId and paymentSourceId but has no rateLimiter behaviour at all.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comments at :214 and :222 say the block is copied from CartController::updateCart(), so a maintainer adding 'apply the coupon at payment time' there would copy the couponCode block too, silently creating an unlimited front-end route into Discounts::orderCouponAvailable().

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A storefront order-recovery/reorder endpoint that copies the control-panel order save and writes order.couponCode from request data.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CP order editor already writes an arbitrary couponCode straight from submitted JSON; copying that block into a storefront controller is the natural way such a feature gets built.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lightweight AJAX 'is this coupon valid?' endpoint that calls getDiscountByCode() directly instead of saving the cart.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getDiscountByCode() is a public service method that returns a discount for a code without touching an order; a theme/plugin wanting instant coupon feedback would call it directly, and no controller-level limiter would cover it.

O9_family: CWE-307: improper restriction of excessive attempts - incomplete IP rate limiting lets an unauthenticated user brute-force / enumerate discount coupon codes

O10_build.toolchain: composer install (no vendor/ at the pinned commit) plus codeception 5 with the craftcms/cms 5.9.15 test harness (`composer testunit` -> `codecept run unit`); ecs/phpstan/rector and node 20 are lint-only, not needed for the tests
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/controllers/CartControllerRateLimitTest.php (rate-limit unit tests incl. testMultipleRequests for the `number` trigger), tests/unit/controllers/CartTest.php (update-cart behaviour), tests/unit/services/DiscountsTest.php (orderCouponAvailable / coupon cases)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the couponCode check inside actionUpdateCart (after the RateLimiter has already run) or bolt on a second separate limiter/key prefix instead of extending the existing behaviour's param list.

out_of_scope_notes: The control-panel order editor also writes an arbitrary couponCode from request data (src/controllers/OrdersController.php:1580 via actionSave at :352, action init() requires the `commerce-manageOrders` permission at :126) with no rate limiting; staff are not the brute-force threat model, so this stays outside the advisory's protection and was not pursued.
